newsitem.title: USA: F.N.B. Corp sells Bucktail Bank for stock.
newsitem.headline: F.N.B. Corp sells Bucktail Bank for stock.

text.p: F.N.B. Corp said Wednesday that its Bucktail Bank and Trust Co will be merged with Sun Bancorp for $17.5 million in stock.

F.N.B. said it will post an after-tax gain of about $5.5 million related to the sale. The period in which the gain will be posted will be determined by the closing date, which is expected to fall in the first quarter of 1997, it said.
Under the agreement, F.N.B. will sell its 100 percent interest in Bucktail to Sun Bancorp for the stock, which represents about 13.8 percent ownership of Sun.
The agreement also would allow F.N.B. to increase its ownership of Sun up to 20 percent, it said. F.N.B. also has been offered two seats on Sun Bancorp's board of directors.
Bucktail, which has total assets of $121 million, is based in Williamsport, Pa. Sun Bancorp, a $355 million holding company that provides financial services, is based in Selinsgrove, Pa.
F.N.B. has assets of $1.7 billion, and operates community banks and a consumer finance company in Pennsylvania, eastern Ohio, and southwestern New York.
